topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: Stepping into the shop, the smell of old wood and cleaner hit me, same as every time. The place hadn't changed much, but I hadn't either, I guess. That ring glinted up at me from the glass case like a star in a cheap dive. It was her ring, no doubt about it. The pawnbroker, Mr. Lee, was surprised when I told him the ring’s history. Turned out, some desperate soul had pawned it weeks back. I nodded slowly, thinking of the stories my grandma used to tell. Mr. Lee sighed, handed it over after a quick chat about the deal. I slipped the ring into my pocket, feeling the weight of it, and stepped back out into the rain, the city around me just a vague blur.
